Fixture: 36_icc_rgb_v4_para_32x32_lossless.icc
Reference ICC profile for 36_icc_rgb_v4_para_32x32_lossless.jxl -- the exact bytes that
codestream's E.4 payload must decode to.

Purpose
-------
tests/e2e_icc.rs compares JPXL's decoded ICC profile against this file byte
for byte. Keeping it in the tree means the slice-4 gate runs in any checkout,
with or without the djxl oracle installed.

Provenance
----------
  Synthetic. Built byte by byte from the ICC.1 structure (128-byte header, tag
  table, tag payloads) by the Python snippet inside tools/make-icc-fixtures.sh,
  which also feeds it to cjxl as -x icc_pathname=... to produce 36_icc_rgb_v4_para_32x32_lossless.jxl.
  No system profile, no third-party profile and no colour-management library
  was read, converted or consulted, so this carries no licence beyond this
  repository's own.

  Size:       504 bytes
  sha256      6877533b29f73479d1b27f257a0b7c41d6c6e7c793d896346da00bedc2d34d4b
  Regenerate: tools/make-icc-fixtures.sh

  Full provenance, including the profile's structure and what it exercises in
  E.4, is in 36_icc_rgb_v4_para_32x32_lossless.jxl.txt.

Verification
------------
tools/make-icc-fixtures.sh refuses to write the pair unless
`djxl --orig_icc_out` extracts a byte-identical profile from 36_icc_rgb_v4_para_32x32_lossless.jxl,
so this file is confirmed to be what the codestream stores.
